title: Probe-ladder sizing root cause: fixed 1-token start plus downward-only search cannot reach profitable sizes
summary: The recommended 'move computation off-chain and go low-latency' direction addresses a latency problem that the system does not currently have. The measured blocker is a sizing-domain defect: the review ladder always starts at exactly 1.0 borrow token and, when that probe is not profitable, searches only DOWNWARD. Measured binding-side capacity of the 94 candidate pools has a median of 0.000253 token, so the ladder start exceeds median pool capacity by roughly 4000x and no ladder can ever reach a profitable size.

probeLadderDirection.onInitialFailureBranch: upper_amount = initial_amount_raw; candidate = bounded_half(initial_amount_raw, min_probe_raw); loop only halves the candidate. There is NO upward branch in the failure path.
probeLadderDirection.onInitialSuccessBranch: doubles upward to max_probe_raw, then binary-refines (this branch works)
probeLadderDirection.conclusion: a profitable size larger than the initial probe is unreachable whenever the initial probe itself reverts

initialAmountDerivation.code: initial_amount_raw = max(1, int(Decimal(10) ** int(borrow_decimals)))  # exactly 1.0 token
initialAmountDerivation.maxProbeAmountRaw: cap_raw from _liquidity_cap_raw, only an UPPER bound, never the start (rust_closed_loop.py:3387)
initialAmountDerivation.conclusion: the ladder start is a hardcoded constant, completely independent of measured pool capacity

productionReviewSample.interpretation: the 59 ladders that actually ran all started at 1.0 token and all failed with NoProfitableRoute; the 276 zero-length probeRecords are reviews that never reached the ladder at all

capacityDistribution.source: rehearsal copy DB %TEMP%\w6_rehearsal3.sqlite3, 94 candidate pools with measured capacity

probeWindowAnalysis.conclusion: 58 of 94 pools are BELOW the ladder floor; only 11 can absorb more than the 1-token start

capacityInformedStartAnalysis.conclusion: a capacity-informed start would make 30-36 pools probeable instead of 25, and would let the ladder climb upward from a reachable point

premisesChecked.noHook: CONFIRMED - 47/47 candidate pools, 114/114 manager pools, 264/264 closed-loop hops carry zero hooks
premisesChecked.pureIntegerMath: ALREADY TRUE - v4_pool_capacity.py uses integer division only; Rust f64 appears solely in business_builder.rs ranking and a RPC throttle interval, never in profit math
premisesChecked.tickCacheWouldHelp: NO - capacity derives from (sqrtPriceX96, liquidity, fee) only; no tickLiquidityNet or tickBitmap exists anywhere in the codebase
premisesChecked.offChain3HopMath: PARTIAL - v4_pool_capacity.py already implements full tick-math capacity, swap_amount_out and price_impact_bps; dex_quote_evidence_pool.py has _spot_amount_out_raw and _annotate_hop_price_impact, but no full 3-hop off-chain route simulator exists
premisesChecked.onChainRecompute: CONFIRMED - preview_arbitrage_best_amount_inner eth_calls OfficialV4FlashArb.previewArbitrageBestAmount, whose internal MAX_AMOUNT_SEARCH_STEPS=24 loops call _probeAmount -> real runArbitrage swaps
premisesChecked.productionBroadcastVolume: ZERO - cow_execution_attempts has 0 rows and manager_v4_review_broadcast_requests has 0 rows, so gas figures and MEV exposure cannot be validated from production data

conclusion.butNotWhereAssumed: the dominant defect is the ladder's starting amount and search direction, not on-chain recompute latency or off-chain quoting. Advice item 7 (drop the off-chain Quoter and blind-send) is unsafe to apply before the sizing fix, because the fallback cap of 64 tokens would then be used as the execution size on a pool whose median capacity is 0.000253 token.

primaryFix.name: capacity-informed, bidirectional probe ladder
changes: derive initial_amount_raw from the measured binding-side capacity of the path's tightest hop instead of the hardcoded 1.0 token
clamp the start into [min_probe_amount_raw, max_probe_amount_raw] and into the capacity of every hop on the path
make the failure branch search UPWARD as well, mirroring the success branch, so a revert at the start does not terminate the search
keep the existing fail-closed 'best_amount_ladder_incomplete' gate unchanged; the ladder must become complete by data repair, never by relaxing the gate

rejectedAdvice: item 1 tick cache - unnecessary, capacity does not depend on tick data
item 7 blind-send without off-chain equivalence - unsafe before the sizing fix and before off-chain 3-hop parity
item 9 hardcoded gasLimit 500000 - no production gasUsed data exists; 3-hop flash loan gas is unmeasured
item 6 tighten slippage now - the bottleneck is zero executable trades, not slippage; the 'no MEV on Robinhood' premise is unverified

recommendedOrder: P0  W6 production depth rollout - unlocks every measurement
P0' D4 capacity-informed bidirectional ladder - restores any chance of a profitable best amount
P1  version-triggered re-evaluation instead of dead-wait
P2  off-chain 3-hop simulator + parity regression vs on-chain preview (only then does blind-send become viable)
P3  WSS incremental state feed and on-chain fallback amount array
P4  slippage policy unification, after the MEV model is verified
P5  deployment and network latency work (direct sequencer, gas policy), after real broadcast gas data exists
constraintsRespected: no production write was performed by this analysis
production DB was opened read-only via file:...?mode=ro
capacity measurements come from the rehearsal copy, not from production
daemon and run.py (PID 30304) were not stopped or restarted
